body.text: In today's competitive Nigerian job market, your resume needs to pass through Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) before it ever reaches human eyes. Major Nigerian companies like Dangote Group, MTN Nigeria, and Access Bank use ATS software to filter thousands of applications daily. Without an ATS-friendly resume template, your qualifications might never be seen, regardless of how impressive they are.

This comprehensive guide will show you exactly how to create and use ATS-friendly resume templates that work specifically for the Nigerian job market, helping you secure interviews at top companies across Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and beyond.
What Makes a Resume Template ATS-Friendly?

An ATS-friendly resume template is designed to be easily read and parsed by applicant tracking systems. These software programs scan resumes for specific keywords, formatting, and information before ranking candidates for human recruiters.
Key characteristics of ATS-friendly templates include:

items: Clean, simple formatting without complex graphics or tables
Standard fonts like Arial, Calibri, or Times New Roman
Clear section headings that ATS can recognize
Strategic keyword placement matching job descriptions

body.text: Nigerian companies increasingly rely on ATS software due to the high volume of applications they receive. Companies like First Bank, Unilever Nigeria, and Nigerian Breweries process thousands of resumes monthly, making ATS optimization crucial for job seekers.

body.text: For Nigerian job seekers, include your state of origin if applying to federal government positions, as this information is often required for quota considerations.
Professional Summary
Replace outdated objective statements with a compelling professional summary. This 3-4 line section should highlight:

items: Key skills relevant to Nigerian market needs
Career goals aligned with the position

body.text: Use keywords from the job posting in your professional summary. If applying for banking roles in Nigeria, include terms like "financial services," "regulatory compliance," and "customer relationship management."
